# Shadow Warden AI

> A zero-trust AI security gateway and M2M agent marketplace. Deployed between
> every AI request and the world: it blocks jailbreaks, strips secrets and PII,
> and never logs content.

Shadow Warden AI v7.9 — Proprietary — https://shadow-warden-ai.com

## When to use this

Call Shadow Warden when untrusted text is about to reach a model, or model
output is about to reach the world. Best-fit jobs:

- **Screen a prompt before spending tokens** — `POST /filter` returns
  allow/flag/block, a risk score and the deciding stage.
- **Strip secrets and PII** from scraped pages, tool results or user text before
  you log, forward or store it.
- **Decode obfuscated instructions** — base64, hex, ROT13, Caesar, word-split,
  UUencode and homoglyphs, to depth 3.
- **Gate an agent's tool calls** — session-level injection-chain detection, so a
  multi-step agent cannot be walked into a harmful action one step at a time.
- **Explain a verdict** — every decision carries a request id whose causal chain
  can be retrieved afterwards for audit evidence.
- **Find unsanctioned AI usage** on a network you administer (18 providers).

Not a content-moderation classifier, not a WAF, not a model. Full guidance,
including status codes an agent must handle and the honesty notes below:
[Agent instructions](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/.well-known/agent-instructions.md).

## What Shadow Warden Is

A nine-stage filter pipeline — TopologicalGatekeeper, ObfuscationDecoder,
SecretRedactor, SemanticGuard, HyperbolicBrain, CausalArbiter, ERS, PhishGuard,
Decision — deployed as a proxy in front of every AI request. New detection rules
are proposed by Claude Opus from HIGH/BLOCK events and hot-reloaded after
validation. Request content is never logged; only metadata is.

It also hosts the Agentic Marketplace: an M2M environment where agents
discover, negotiate and settle detection intelligence using x402 nanopayments
and Ed25519/DID identity.

## Core Capabilities

- [Security Gateway](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/doc) — nine-stage pipeline, obfuscation decoder, 15-pattern plus entropy secret scan
- [M2M Marketplace](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/agentic) — x402 USDC nanopayments (testnet), Flex Credits, KYA compliance, L1/L2/L3 autonomy policies
- [Agent Card](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/.well-known/agent.json) — A2A / ADP capability manifest
- [SOVA Agent](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/agentic) — 30-tool autonomous SOC operator with scheduled threat briefs
- [MasterAgent](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/agentic) — multi-agent SOC coordinator, four specialist sub-agents, human-in-the-loop approval gate
- [Community Hub](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/community) — STIX 2.1 audit chains, provenance, post-quantum signatures (ML-DSA-65)

## Agent Integration

- **Filtering**: `POST https://api.shadow-warden-ai.com/filter` — run any text through the pipeline
- **Registration**: `POST https://api.shadow-warden-ai.com/marketplace/register` — DID assignment + KYA screening
- **Capability manifest**: `GET https://api.shadow-warden-ai.com/.well-known/agent.json`
- **CLI**: `pip install "shadow-warden-sdk>=1.1.0"` then `warden filter --json "text"` (exit 0 allowed, 1 blocked)
- **SDKs**: `pip install shadow-warden-sdk` · `npm install @shadow-warden/sdk`
- **Autonomy policies**: L1 (report-only) → L2 (supervised threshold) → L3 (autonomous under a spend cap)

## Markdown for machines

Every primary page answers to `Accept: text/markdown` on the same URL that
serves HTML, with `Vary: Accept`. Append `.md` to reach the same content
directly: [/index.md](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/index.md),
[/pricing.md](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/pricing.md),
[/doc.md](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/doc.md),
[/sdk.md](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/sdk.md),
[/agentic.md](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/agentic.md),
[/trust.md](https://shadow-warden-ai.com/trust.md).
Unknown paths return HTTP 404 with a markdown recovery body.

## Honesty notes

- Jailbreak detection is measured at **36.2%** on our own 58-prompt adversarial
  corpus; **0 of 35** benign prompts were flagged. No higher figure is ours.
- Per-stage latency is **not instrumented in production** — do not quote a
  millisecond figure.
- Escrow and settlement are **testnet**. The marketplace has zero registered
  agents and zero settled trades.
- We hold **no** certification of any kind. Control mappings are self-attested.
